description: Fully updated for 2026 — now with TikTok Shop, Etsy's current fee structure, and how to get found by AI shopping assistants. Sell Your Crafts Online is a working manual, not a pep talk. Between step-by-step how-tos and checklists, Dillehay's proven strategies put your products in front of buyers who are ready to spend. title: How to Start Selling on Etsy: A Beginner’s Guide to Opening Your First Shop
description: You’ve thought about opening an Etsy shop. Now let’s help you get past the thinking part. Maybe you make something people keep telling you to sell. Maybe you enjoy designing printables, finding vintage treasures, or creating gifts that deserve more attention than a compliment at the kitchen table. But when you sit down to start, the questions pile up. What can you sell? What should you charge? What does Etsy keep? And how will anyone find your shop? Suddenly, your exciting idea feels like homework. Let’s change that. How to Start Selling on Etsy: A Beginner’s Guide to Opening Your First Shop walks you through getting started in clear, everyday language. Think of a patient friend sitting beside you, explaining what to do next—with practical examples and a little humor along the way. You’ll learn how to choose a manageable first product, understand selling costs, set a price that accounts for your work, and prepare photos and descriptions that help buyers understand what they’re getting. You’ll also work through opening your shop, preparing a digital download, choosing relevant search words, and handling those first customer questions. No business degree required. No need to turn your dining room into a warehouse before you begin. This short guide gives you room to learn without burying you in hundreds of pages. You can read it through or keep it beside you while you get your product ready. That idea you keep coming back to? Give it a place to go.
